title: Estagiário em Supply Chain
description:
*Resumo
Sobre a Enerflex *
A Enerflex é uma empresa global de soluções integradas para os setores de energia, com presença consolidada em mais de 20 países. Sediada no Canadá e com operações no Brasil, oferecemos expertise em engenharia, fabricação, instalação e serviços pós-venda para sistemas de compressão de gás natural, geração de energia e processamento de hidrocarbonetos. Comprometida com os mais altos padrões de segurança, inovação e sustentabilidade, a Enerflex atua com excelência em projetos que impulsionam a eficiência energética em todo o mundo.

Sobre a Oportunidade
Estamos em busca de jovens comprometidos(as) com o desenvolvimento técnico e profissional, que queiram iniciar uma carreira sólida em uma empresa referência no setor de Óleo e Gás. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais em início de carreira que desejam trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto padrão técnico e oportunidades reais de crescimento.

Cargo: Estágiario de Supply Chain

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ

*Principais responsabilidades e deveres *

  • Apoiar na condução de processos de compras de baixa e média complexidade, nacionais einternacionais;
  • Auxiliar no relacionamento com fornecedores e áreas internas para alinhamento dedemandas;
  • Contribuir com o mapeamento de oportunidades para redução de custos e melhoria deprocessos;
  • Apoiar na gestão e controle de materiais, além de realizar cadastros no sistema ERP;
  • Elaborar e atualizar relatórios e indicadores de desempenho da área (KPIs);
  • Apoiar o time em análises diversas e em tarefas administrativas relacionadas à área deSuprimentos.

*Qualificações *

  • Cursando graduação em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas;
  • Ter, no mínimo, 1 ano disponível até a conclusão do curso;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e senso de urgência;
  • Proatividade, ética e disposição para aprender;
  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Inglês intermediário(leitura, escrita e conversação básica) – desejável;
  • Pacote Office – Nível intermediário (ênfase em Excel);
  • Power BI – Conhecimento básico será considerado diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão (ERP) – desejável;
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

*Condições de Trabalho *

  • Local: Escritório no Centro do Rio de Janeiro – atuação 100% presencial;
  • Carga horária: 6 horas diárias (30 horas semanais);
  • Regime de contratação: Estágio;
  • Duração: 12 a 24 meses, conforme disponibilidade do estudante;
  • Relacionamento direto com o time de Suprimentos e interface com áreas internas e fornecedores;
  • Ambiente corporativo, colaborativo e com foco no desenvolvimento do estagiário.

Sobre nós:
Transformando energia para um futuro sustentável. A Enerflex é a principal fornecedora global integrada de soluções de infraestrutura de energia, abrangendo soluções de processamento de gás, compressão, geração de energia, refrigeração, criogênica, transição energética e água. Temos orgulho de empregar mais de 5.000 funcionários altamente qualificados em mais de 25 países em todo o mundo.

A Enerflex coloca seus valores fundamentais de integridade, comprometimento, criatividade e sucesso em ação em todos os aspectos do negócio. Nossa inovação, forte compromisso com a segurança e serviço superior aos nossos clientes nos posicionam como o parceiro ideal para atender às necessidades do dinâmico setor de energia.

Promovemos uma cultura de garantir que nossos funcionários tenham as ferramentas para realizar seu trabalho corretamente, mas também para prosperar em suas funções. Temos orgulho de nossos salários competitivos, extensos programas de recompensas, celebração do sucesso de indivíduos e equipes e estamos comprometidos em garantir que a Enerflex continue sendo um espaço seguro e inclusivo para todos.

A Enerflex é uma empregadora que oferece oportunidades iguais
A Enerflex concede oportunidades iguais de emprego a todas as pessoas qualificadas, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo, idade, nacionalidade, religião, informação genética, deficiência física ou mental ou qualquer outra característica protegida pela legislação federal, estadual ou local aplicável. Oportunidades iguais de emprego são oferecidas em recrutamento, contratação, promoções, salários, benefícios e outros termos, condições e privilégios de emprego.

title: Overlay Cluster Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

Role to transition into onsite Overlay Venue Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and key stakeholders to define, optimize, and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Contribute to procurement and tendering processes by preparing technical inputs for RFPs, supporting technical evaluations, and managing overlay contractors and suppliers across assigned venues.
  • Manage change control and budget tracking for venues within the cluster, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule alignment.
  • Coordinate and oversee the flow of technical information, including drawings, requirements, and updates, across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain alignment with stadium authorities by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Oversee overlay delivery from planning through construction, operations, and reinstatement, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely handover.
  • Track progress, milestones, and deliverables, providing regular status updates and supporting the resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Support operational design development by consolidating raw data into compliant base drawings and ensuring consistent coding and naming conventions for effective tracking and change management.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese; additional language(s) is an asset.
  • Availability to travel as needed
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027

title: Fiscal de pátio e pista
description:
Um aeroporto com a alma carioca

O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 11 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

Aqui somos contagiados pelo Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser, onde nossos Integrantes atuam com garra e determinação para alcançar resultados, são incentivados a buscar o autodesenvolvimento, sendo agentes do próprio destino profissional, trabalham em equipe com colaboração e empatia e são norteados por um espírito de dono, cuidando e perseguindo sempre os melhores resultados.

Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos à todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Fiscal de Pátio e Pista. 

Esse desafio requer que você desempenhe as seguintes atividades:

  • Atuar no monitoramento, fiscalização e/ou execução de atividades operacionais no lado ar do aeroporto, com objetivo de garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos de segurança operacional do Aeroporto;
  • Fiscalizar e realizar inspeções diárias nos pátios, pistas e taxiways;
  • Acoplar e desacoplar ponte de embarque/desembarque de passageiros;
  • Realizar o procedimento de sinalização para o estacionamento de aeronaves (marshalling);
  • Orientar e auxiliar aeronaves, veículos e pessoas no pátio de acordo com os procedimentos, garantindo a segurança operacional;
  • Acompanhar as atividades inerentes à operação de todo voo (carregamento, descarregamento e pushback);
  • Monitorar e fiscalizar atividades operacionais executadas por empresas aéreas, ESATAS tal como o tráfego e condições de uso de veículos e equipamentos na área operacional;
  • Elaborar relatórios operacionais e relatos de inspeções operacionais.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com outras áreas operacionais (RIOgaleão, ESATAS, Órgãos Públicos, Cias Aéreas e demais prestadores de serviço) para que o RIOgaleão seja referência em segurança e eficiência.

Habilidades e qualificações necessárias:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • CNH categoria D ou B;
  • Habilidade de autogestão;
  • Resiliência para lidar com problemas, adaptar-se a mudanças e resistir a pressões;
  • Proatividade;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e sede por aprendizado;
  • Atitudes GATE do Integrante RIOgaleão: Garra e Determinação, Autodesenvolvimento, Trabalho em Equipe e Espírito de Dono;

Você sai na frente se:

  • Tiver experiência na área da aviação;
  • Conhecimento em RBAC153, RBAC 154 e afins.

Além desse desafio profissional, a nossa oportunidade abrange um pacote de benefícios diferenciado. Confira só

Vale Refeição - Cuide da sua alimentação com R$1.315,78 mensais para escolher suas refeições preferidas e se alimentar bem todos os dias.

Plano de Saúde Bradesco - Tenha acesso a uma rede de saúde de qualidade com o Plano de Saúde Bradesco, garantindo seu bem-estar e cuidado com a saúde.

Seguro de Vida Prudential - Sinta-se seguro e protegido com o Seguro de Vida Prudential, pensado para você e seus entes queridos.

Assistência Odontológica SulAmérica - Sorria sem preocupações com a nossa assistência odontológica da SulAmérica, que cuida da sua saúde bucal.

Vale Transporte - Deslocamento garantido Aproveite o vale transporte ou vale mobilidade sem nenhum custo.

Gympass - Cuide do seu corpo e da sua mente com planos flexíveis e acessíveis através do Gympass, para se exercitar onde e quando quiser.

Parcerias com Instituições de Ensino e Lazer - Desfrute de descontos exclusivos em cursos e atividades de lazer com nossas parcerias.

description:
Resumo do cargo:
Proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.
Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:
1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.
Quem você é:
Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.
Para este cargo, você precisará:
Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:
Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Senior Product Manager - Feegow (100  remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

How does Docplanner Tech fit here?

At Docplanner Tech we are a diverse group of over 400 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you'd like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here's a video of us. 

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We're not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

Job Description

You will be responsible for:

  • Define and set key results for your team to ensure the product works smoothly for our clients. 

  • Lead a product team, working together with the operations, business, development, design, business intelligence, and marketing teams to discuss problems. 

  • Monitor and analyze customer behavior regarding launched features and measure against KPIs. 

  • Regular communication with customers to understand their pain points and needs.

  • Work with Stakeholders from different areas and other departments to balance business goals and customer needs, ensuring that relevant issues are debated, decided on, and initiatives are delivered.

  • Lead and define short, medium, and long-term strategies related to company growth, internal improvements, and the development of new features that meet the goals of the Docplanner Group;

  • Engage all internal and external stakeholders with the product vision, listening to and understanding their pain points to ensure the organization's strategic pillars are met.

  • Use product management methods and tools to prioritize deliveries, experiment with hypotheses, and test them.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, combining their skills to solve the problems of clinics and healthcare institutions - managers, billers, financial managers.

  • Evaluate existing solutions within the company, utilize internal resources, and optimize solutions that are tangible, with lower costs and time investment.

  • Deliver assertive solutions with your team that truly solve the presented problem. 

  • Solve problems pragmatically and assertively, aligning with the company's strategic pillars.

  • Ask the right questions to choose and collect the correct metrics and indicators for building dashboards.

  • Discuss, defend, and report processes, ideas, and projects to the Docplanner Global Team, with an emphasis on knowledge of the Brazilian market.

  • Build, evaluate, and support the creation of documentation for improvements, creation, and modification of features to inform the development and operations teams about ongoing projects.

Qualifications

What experience and skills do you need to do great at this position? 

  • 4+ years of experience in product management with a proven track record of delivering successful products

  • Masterminds of numbers Excellent in analyzing, and synthesizing product usage data to provide actionable insights.

  • High level of energy, ownership, and strong communication skills.

  • Focus on the user, with the ability to identify and prioritize opportunities to reach your team's goals.

  • "Hands-on" approach with the ability to adapt quickly to a fast-paced working environment + you're able to switch between strategic high-level thinking and hands-on operational work.

  • Ability to dynamically and pertinently connect business, technology, and design issues for objective and assertive decision-making;

  • Experience with complex problems and presenting impactful solutions to resolve such problems;

  • Experience in analyzing users' pains and needs, validating hypotheses, running market experiments, scoping products/services, and taking a product to the market.

  • Fluency in English is required, as this position involves collaboration with global teams.

A big Bonus if you: 

  • worked with the healthcare industry.

  • are an interdisciplinary entrepreneur (own start-up experience, even if it was a failure).

Additional Information

Our interview processo typically includes:

  1. CV Review (done by human)
  2. Talent Acquisition Interview - 45 min
  3. Hiring Manager Interview - 60 min
  4. Whitebord Interview - 60 min
  5. Stakeholder Interview - 60min

Each step is designed to help both you and our team understand whether this is a strong mutual fit. We'll guide you through each stage so you always know what's coming

Let's talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$20.000,00 and R$28.000,00 BRL CLT. The range is broad so that we can accommodate our roles for all levels of experience, but we will show you the career ladder to explain where we see your skills and impact within the company". Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

  • We offer a Meal Voucher worth R$800,00 a month, but if you enjoy cooking at home, you can replace it with a Food Voucher, for the same amount, or do half and half, making life easier for those who are 100% remote or hybrid.

  • For the commute to the office, we offer transportation vouchers.

  • We have a robust Partnerships Club, with agreements and discounts ranging from educational institutions. such as colleges and languages, to exclusive banking benefits.

  • Share options plan after 6 months of working with us.

  • Did you like working here? Then refer a friend or relative We love having family and friends around Our New Warrior Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in.

  • Our working hours are Monday through Friday, from 9am to 6pm.

  • Need to work beyond your usual hours? We have a time bank so that you can use those hours as time off later.

  • Additional paid holiday on your birthday and work anniversary.

  • Our special leave policies are different here: if you've lost a loved one, we offer 10 days off; if you lose your PET, you have 2 days. Are you getting married? 7 days of rest The baby's here? We offer 1-month of paternity leave and 6 months of maternity leave.

Health comes first 

  • Medical and Dental Assistance along with Group Life Insurance.

  • We have a robust Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services, all the way to exclusive banking benefits.

  • Access to the iFeel app, for emotional comfort, which combines traditional psychology with AI, helping you through those tough days.

  • ApoioPass offers free professional support and guidance in the psychological, legal, economic, and social areas, providing support in those more delicate issues.

  • A Gympass for you and 3 other people Because working out alone is very boring, isn't it?

  • Did you think your PET would be left out? Of course not We offer a Pet Plan extending the care to your pet as well.

  • Credits: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment.

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference.  If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you're reading, there's a person (hi) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we're lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you've never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

title: Freelance Automotive Engineer with Python Experience
description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation isproject-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Design graduate- and industry-level automotive engineering problems grounded in real practice;
  • Evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness, assumptions, and engineering logic;
  • Validate analytical or numerical results using Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas);
  • Improve AI reasoning to align with first principles and accepted engineering standards;
  • Apply structured scoring criteria to assess multi-step problem solving.

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for automotive engineers with an experience in python open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have: 

  • Degree in Automotive Engineering or related fields, e.g. Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, etc.
  • 3+ years of professional automotive engineering experience
  • Strong written English (C1/C2)
  • Strong Python proficiency for numerical validation
  • Stable internet connection 

Professional certifications (e.g., PE, CEng, PMP) and experience in international or applied projects are an advantage.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Payment

  • Paid contributions, with rates up to $13/hour* 
  • Fixed project rate or individual rates, depending on the project
  • Some projects include incentive payments

*Note: Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be offered to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

About Foundey
Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States.
We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences.
With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer.
This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.
Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.
Requirements
Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.
Preferred Qualifications
5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.
Why Join Us?
At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide.
You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.
How to Apply
If you're a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Program Manager, Grantee Experience
description:
Program Manager, Grantee Experience - Independent Contractor

Scope of Services

This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employment role. The successful contractor will provide services under a defined scope and will not be engaged as an employee.

1. Project Overview

Tilt Collective is engaging an independent contractor to provide program and grantee engagement support to strengthen relationships with partners and grantees across key portfolios. The engagement will initially focus on Brazil and US grant making, with additional support across Tilt Collective's countries and programs as required.

The Contractor will provide specialist support to enhance program implementation, strengthen compliance processes, and improve communication between Tilt Collective and its organizational partners. The Contractor will operate independently, using their own professional expertise and judgement, while collaborating with Tilt Collective stakeholders as needed to deliver the agreed services.

2. Scope of Services and Deliverables

The Contractor will provide the following services. Percentages indicate anticipated focus and do not guarantee a minimum or maximum time allocation.

A. Partner relationship management and communication (approximately 40%)

  • Act as an additional point of contact for routine partner and grantee communications, as agreed with Tilt Collective

  • Facilitate structured check-ins with partner grantees, in coordination with relevant Program Staff, to support progress tracking and issue identification

  • Coordinate translation support and cross-cultural communication requirements, particularly in Brazil

  • Support strategic communications between Tilt Collective and grantee partners
    Provide input and recommendations to help maintain productive partner relationships aligned with program objectives

B. Grant making process support (approximately 40%)

  • Support the adaptation and localisation of grant making policies, processes, and documentation to improve accessibility and contextual relevance, particularly for Brazil

  • Draft and contribute to internal grant making documents, including nomination forms and investment memos

  • Review grant proposals and provide written assessments against agreed strategic and program criteria

  • Support compliance and due diligence processes by preparing documentation and inputs as requested by the Grants Team

  • Contribute recommendations to improve grantmaking tools, procedures, and documentation

C. Additional grantee engagement and learning support (approximately 20%)

  • Support the implementation and use of MEAL tracking tools to monitor grantee progress and outcomes

  • Contribute to the preparation of progress updates and summary reports for internal or external use

  • Identify themes, trends, and learning points across grantee engagement and share insights with Tilt Collective stakeholders

3. Term and Time Commitment

The anticipated start date is as soon as reasonably practicable, with an expected commencement by Q1 2026.

The engagement is expected to average up to 20 hours per week for planning purposes. Tilt Collective guarantees a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week for the first six months of the engagement.

Hours above this level may be required by mutual agreement and in line with agreed deliverables and timelines. The Contractor retains discretion over how and when the services are performed, subject to meeting those deliverables and timelines.

4. Collaboration and Communications

The Contractor will work primarily with the Grants Director, who will serve as the primary point of contact. Regular touchpoints may be scheduled to align on priorities, deliverables, and timelines. These touchpoints are intended for coordination and information sharing and do not create a reporting or supervisory relationship.

5. Performance and Deliverables

Successful delivery will be assessed based on the quality, timeliness, and completeness of agreed outputs, including but not limited to:

  • Grant making documents produced

  • Proposal reviews and written assessments completed

  • Partner and grantee engagement activities delivered

  • Contributions to process improvement and learning

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including the Grants Team and Program or Country leadership, may be used to inform the overall assessment of the services delivered.

6. Fees and Payment

Fees will be paid monthly following submission of an invoice detailing services provided during the applicable period, in accordance with the agreed contract terms. Finance will confirm final payment mechanics separately.

Contractor Skills / Requirements

  • Necessity for fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English 

  • Location in Brazil, USA, or a similar time zone 

  • Ability to commit for six months

title: Auxiliar de Expedição
description:
Na Pro Water, acreditamos que o nosso resultado é construído no dia a dia por pessoas que fazem acontecer — com organização, responsabilidade e segurança. Trabalhar com a gente não é só ocupar uma vaga: é entrar para um time que valoriza respeito, cooperação e crescimento profissional.

Se você é uma pessoa mão na massa, atenta aos detalhes e quer trabalhar em um ambiente onde o seu esforço faz diferença de verdade, essa pode ser a sua oportunidade

Na prática, sua rotina costuma ser assim:

  • Separação (picking): buscar produtos/insumos no estoque conforme a lista, conferindo código, quantidade e condição.
  • Conferência: checar se tudo o que foi separado está correto antes de seguir no fluxo.
  • Embalagem e etiquetagem: embalar corretamente, identificar com etiqueta e organizar por pedido/rota na área de expedição.
  • Organização para embarque: separar mercadorias por destino, mantendo o fluxo do armazém funcionando (sem "engarrafar" a doca/área de saída).
  • Carga e descarga: apoiar no carregamento e descarregamento de caminhões com atenção a peso, empilhamento e estabilidade, seguindo práticas seguras.
  • Devoluções por avaria: inspecionar materiais retornados, avaliar se dá para reembalar e reinserir no fluxo; quando necessário, encaminhar para produção para correção/remoção da avaria.
  • Limpeza e organização: manter o setor limpo, corredores desobstruídos e itens no lugar certo; zelar pelos equipamentos e materiais de trabalho.
  • Apoio ao estoque: participar de contagens, registros simples de movimentação e ajustes com validação da supervisão.

O que você precisa saber sobre o trabalho

  • Rotina operacional, com movimentação constante, trabalho em pé e momentos de esforço físico (principalmente em carga/descarga).
  • Trabalho em equipe, seguindo prioridades e combinados do turno.
  • Segurança faz parte do dia a dia: atenção ao manuseio, empilhamento, circulação e procedimentos da área.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Fundamental
  • Disponibilidade para escala 12x36
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe

Diferenciais

  • Curso de Operador de Empilhadeira
  • Curso de Trabalho em Altura (NR-35)

title: Assistente de Telefonia
description:
Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando o foco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesquelético e de terapia assistida.

Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história, mas para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores:

FOCO NAS PESSOAS

Nossos valores


Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo

Venha fazer história com a gente

SomosVitus #PorUmaVidaSemDor


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais atividades:

  • Atendimento via telefone, e-mail, whats app e chat;
  • Marcação de consultas e exames;
  • Suporte da recepção;
  • Captação de novo pacientes.

Benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico, Total Pass e Vale Transporte

O Grupo Vitus nasceu em 2019 com o objetivo de expandir a nossa forma de cuidar e valorizar a saúde dos nossos pacientes, com o propósito de criarum Brasil ativo e sem dor. Somos formados por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde. Atualmente estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo realizando mais de 120 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 40 mil pacientes.

Nosso ecossistema é formado por diversas marcas que estão distribuídas em três unidades de negócio: Ortopedia, Terapia Assistida e Reabilitação Digital.

Nossa estrutura foi constituída de modo a fornecer aos nossos pacientes: consultas, com um corpo clínico de excelência; exames, de última geração; tratamentos medicamentosos, terapia assistida com certificação internacional e reabilitação presencial e digital.

title: profissional especialista de civil
description:
A SANDECH foi fundada em 2008, na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, com o propósito de desenvolver projetos multidisciplinares para o setor industrial. Desde então, temos atuado em diversos segmentos da economia brasileira, como óleo e gás, químico e petroquímico, farmacêutico e siderúrgico. Até então, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, consolidando um portfólio robusto com clientes de grande porte, como Petrobras, BRASKEM, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau.

Com foco em inovação, a SANDECH adota tecnologias avançadas, como drones, laser scan, integração ao modelo BIM e óculos de realidade virtual, sempre buscando otimizar processos e elevar o nível de precisão e eficiência de seus projetos. Esse compromisso com a excelência também se reflete no Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, certificado internacionalmente pela ABS Quality Evaluations na norma ISO 9001:2015 e aprovado em auditorias realizadas por cinco de seus principais clientes. Com um SGQ maduro e bem estruturado, estamos habilitados a executar projetos de engenharia considerados críticos.

Mais do que uma empresa de engenharia, a SANDECH se posiciona como um parceiro estratégico de seus clientes, unindo experiência técnica, inovação e qualidade. Em constante crescimento, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a excelência e com a construção de soluções cada vez mais eficientes e sustentáveis para a indústria brasileira.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de projetos estruturais em estruturas metálicas;

  • Assegurar o uso adequado da metodologia BIM em todas as fases do projeto.

  • Inglês fluente.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architect. Rio de Janeiro. Posting Date: 01/16/2026. Deadline: 01/29/2026
Role Title: Enterprise Architect
Contract Type: Regular
Reporting To: Deputy CIO
Program/Department/Unit Name: Information Technology
Location: Rio & Mexico City
Team Name: IT Governance
Role Purpose
The Enterprise Architect role is responsible for designing and managing the overall architecture of an organization's IT systems and infrastructure. This role involves aligning IT strategy with business goals, creating architectural frameworks, and ensuring that technology solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient. The Enterprise Architect collaborates with various internal and external stakeholders to identify technology needs and guide the implementation of IT initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
As the Enterprise Architect, your key responsibilities are as follows:
Establish EA governance, EA frameworks, EA methodology and create EA artifacts, EA standards and best practices.
Design and promote architectural standards, guidelines, and best practices across the organization.
Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform architectural decisions and recommendation
Facilitate architecture review boards and governance processes to ensure compliance with architectural standards.
Provide guidance and support to project teams in implementing architectural solutions.
Instruct, manage, and mentor development teams
Communicate enterprise architecture with other department managers within the organization, outsourcing providers and report on continuous improvement initiatives.
Oversee Change Control board, participate in Project Review Board to ensure adherence to architectural standards.
People Responsibilities (Total Team/DRs)
No
Key metrics
EA KPIs such as strategic alignment, business process optimization, innovation enablement, efficiency, architecture compliance and risk management
Key internal relationships
CIO, Deputy CIO, Functional leads, Operations leads, GDPR team, Legal, Finance, Global Security, IT Security, Technology Services, System/Application Owners, Program/Opportunity leads.
Key external relationships
IT vendors in various markets, external consulting experts, EA colleagues at non-profit institutions with similar IT landscape, large global software providers, etc.
The ideal candidate
Essential
Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field
Master's degree in IT management, business management, or enterprise architecture
Certifications such TOGAF, CISSP (for cybersecurity focus), and cloud-specific certifications from providers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud are beneficial
10 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Architecture, with a background in software engineering, network security, cloud computing, systems analysis, data management or other related fields.
Strong understanding of business needs, technology trends, and architectural frameworks.
Experience creating and maintaining comprehensive Enterprise Architecture frameworks.
Experience with architecture modelling tools CAD, BIM, and 3D modelling software.
Strong understanding of IT enterprise systems and platforms (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday) and architectures
Deep knowledge of various technologies, including cloud computing, data management, networking, and security.
Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to analyse complex business problems and develop innovative solutions.
Ability to lead and mentor development teams and influence stakeholders.
Experience with architectural frameworks and methodologies TOGAF or Zachman, and agile methodologies.
Experience with cloud computing, network security, data management, and application integration.
High level understanding and interest of geo-political implications of Open Society's work.
Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.
Languages
An excellent knowledge of English
What We Offer
Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
Excellent benefits and perks to promote well-being and a healthy work-life balance, including:
Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
Employer-paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.
Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.
The salary range for this role in the US is $ 145,666 - $ 161,851 (USD). The final offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set and level of experience
Who We Are
Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time-limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.
Guided by our founder's values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.
Additional Information
Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.
Competitive rates of pay apply.
